text:
The early crew reviewed a point about spare blankets, and we are glad to have your full message. You shared that your companion animal did not get the careful handling, smooth transfer, and clear follow-up you expected during a disrupted trip, and that this left you frustrated and worried.

We are sorry for the strain this caused. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is built around steady care and calm handling, especially when a journey changes shape. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and that standard applies to each animal in our care. When service slips, we want the path back to support to be simple and respectful.

We have noted your report and passed it to the senior coordinator for review in the service ledger. We also want to make sure the details are handled in a way that helps with any follow-up tied to the trip itself. <<FACT F116>> We will keep the record aligned with the trip file so the next step is easier to track.

If the crate was delayed or could not be located, we understand how unsettling that is for both traveler and pet. <<FACT F112>> Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and when that standard is missed we work to correct it with care rather than excuses.

Please keep any photos, receipts, and trip notes with your records, since clear documentation helps us move the case forward cleanly. If you have already shared those items, thank you for doing that. If anything else needs to be added, send it through the same channel and we will attach it to the file. We also use the desk ledger to capture service changes, so your report will stay connected to the full journey history.

We are sorry again for the rough stretch in your travel. Your trust matters to us, and we want the next contact from the Companion Animal Travel Desk to feel more reassuring and more useful.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
